test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate collocating word to fill in the blank.**

I listened to him with ______ attention.
solution:
The correct answer is **rapt**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The appropriate collocating word for the given blank is 'rapt'.**
 
• If someone watches or listens with **rapt attention,** they are extremely interested or fascinated.
 
 
• Example: He watched the ball with rapt attention.</stro
